tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gza' bdud dug gi spu gri'i las byang ngag sgrig bstan dgra 'joms pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ gza' bdud rā hu la'i phrin las ngag khrigs su bkod pa la/ gnas yid dang mthun par sgrub pa las sbyor dang 'brel tshe/ gzhung so so nas bshad pa'i bca' gzhi ltar bya zhing*/ gzhan du gsol kha dang 'gyu dus kyi gtor 'bul lam/ gtor ma la brten pa'i las sgrub tshe/ lcags sam gser phor du gza'i rwa bshos la bshos bu zur gsum dgus bskor ba'i mtshams rnams su ong skyu dang ril bu dgus bskor ba/ gtor ma rnams kyi rtse mor ling ga byi'u tshugs su btsugs pa/ bsnyen sgrub dang rten gtor la so so'i tsaka li dang gdugs mthing nag btsugs/ mchod gtor la mi dgos/ rab gnas dang ldan pa'i dar nag gi bris sku bkram/ gzhan yang tshogs dang*/ sman/ rak+ta/ sha sna/ dkar mngar sogs mchod pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bshams/ de'i mdun du mchod pa rnams kyang las gzhung ltar bshams/ rnga dung sogs rol mo dang nyer mkho'i yo byad 'du bya/ bde ba'i stan la bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i rak+ta'i yon chab| mkhris pa'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog /sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ khrag chen gyi dri chab/ tsit+ta'i zhal zas/ drag po'i rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shapada'i bar gyis dang*/ sman raka gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhan+dha rlon pa skra'i lcang lo can gyi nang du/ sman raka gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ sngags rnams gsum gsum brjod/ mdun bskyed ni/ bsnyen sgrub dang rten gtor byed na/ bris sku dang gtor ma lhar bskyed/

dus gtor dang mchod gtor lhar mi bskyed la/ bsnyen pa dang las sbyor gyi sgrub pa dang gtor ma lhar bskyed/ mchod gtor dang*/ rtags gtor/ thun gtor sogs gud du bshams dgos/ rten gtor yin na mdun du gsol mchod kyi gtor ma bshams pa sogs kyi rnam dbye shes dgos so// rten dang gtor ma sogs bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du ma rig 'dus pa ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi khong gseng*/ dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho la ser sna'i lbu ba dmar ser 'khrigs pa/ phrag dog drag po'i rlung gis bskyod cing g.yon du 'khor ba'i rba rlabs can/ tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i sgra skad dang ldan pa'i zhe sdang me dpung gi tshogs 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dbus su chu las chu bur drag po'i tshul du yi ge kaṃ dmar nag me stag 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ drang srong chen po gza' bdud rā hu la sku mdog dmar nag du kha 'jigs su rung ba/ rtsa zhal gshin rje'i zhal gsum sku'i mdog can/ mche ba gtsigs shing mi ro za ba/ g.yas zhal lha'i zhal gsum dkar zhing bzhad pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba nyi zla'i rjes gcod| g.yon zhal bdud kyi zhal gsum ljang gu ljags 'dril zhing phaṭa sgra sgrog pa/ dbu dgu 'bar ba srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du bskyod pa'i me 'od kyi klong gis stong gsum 'gengs pa'i rtse mor bya rog khros pa'i gdong pa kha gdangs shing hūm̐ gi sgra 'byin pa/ spyan mig dmar po khams gsum gzigs shing nyes byed gdug pa can la mthong ba'i dug 'bebs pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan ral gri'i yu ba can phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/

g.yon dang pos shin tu rno ba'i dug sbrul gyi zhags pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa gdengs pa/ 'og ma gnyis rwa gzhu gnam lcags kyi mda' can rab tu btang bas dgra bgegs kyi snying la gzir ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba can/ sku la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi sbrul gyi ga shas brgyan pa/ sku stod glog ltar 'khyug pas bar snang gang ba/ sku smad lto 'gro 'khyil ba'i gzugs kyis rgya mtsho dkrugs pa/ mgo lus thams cad mig gis khengs pa'i sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ sku las gnam lcags kyi tsha tsha 'phro ba/ zhal nas nad kyi rlangs pa 'phyo zhing*/ shangs nas drag po'i thor rlung 'bud pa/ myur mgyogs drag shul gyi stobs dang ldan pas dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol ba/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla ru tra'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// de'i g.yas su ra las yab srin po yak+sha dz+wa la sngo nag zhal gsum pa/ g.yas seng chen kha g.yal ba/ g.yon g.yag rgod rngam pa'i tshul can/ dbus srin po khros pa'i gdong can mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa dmar po la rgyu skar gyi thod gdengs can/ spyan gsum pa smin ma me ltar 'bar zhing ba spu las thog ser gyi tho lum 'khrugs pa/ snyan nas 'brug gi sgra drag po ldir zhing*/ shangs nas dud 'thul sprin du 'khrigs pa/ phyag g.yas dbyug to phyar zhing g.yon khrag mtsho dkrug cing rngub pa dug sbrul gyi ga sha dang*/ glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol zhing thal ba'i mtshan mas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bsgrad stabs kyis gnas pa'o// g.yon du na las yum rdo rje glog 'gyu ma sku mdog dmar nag zhal gnyis ma rtsa zhal chu srin drag po'i sgra skad sgrog pa/ steng zhal ban lang rngam pa'i 'brug sgra 'byin pa/ ral pa sprug pa'i skra gseb nas sdom sdig chu srin char du 'bebs pa/ ba spu las thog ser 'bebs shing me 'bar ba/ kha rlangs nad kyi sprin 'khrugs shing*/

phyag g.yas sbrul zhags nag po dang*/ g.yon khrag zor 'phen pa/ mdze shu dang g.yen pa'i stod slog la sbrul nag 'jigs pa'i go zu nya phran gyi cha gas mdzes pa/ sku smad sbrul mjug gis rgya mtsho skyom pa/ bā su rigs brgyad 'khor du sdud pa'o// de rnams kyi phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad la/ nub tu ma las ljang sngon chen po thog ser dang gri 'thab gtong ba'i bdag po/ sku mdog dmar nag dbu dgu phyag gnyis kyi g.yon lcags sgrogs dmar po 'dzin pa/ shar lhor tsha las drang srong chen po thog ser dang nad yams gtong ba'i bdag po/ sku mdog dkar ser dbu dgu phyag gnyis kyis g.yon tri shū la dar nag can thogs pa/ byang du du las bdud po rok+ti thog ser yams nad gtong ba'i bdag po/ sku mdog mthing ga dbu dgu phyag gnyis kyi g.yon bdud zhags nag po 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tsa las bi tri pa tra thog ser nad 'khrug gi bdag po/ sku mdog ser nag dbu dgu phyag gnyis kyi g.yon urmo'i ral gri gdengs pa/ shar du ma la biṣ+ṇu ra tsa thog ser dang dmu rdo yams kyi bdag po/ sku mdog dud kha dbu dgu phyag gnyis kyi g.yon stag mgo 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ya las du ba mjug ring thog ser dang skye 'gro'i tshe srog gi bdag po/ sku mdog sngo nag dbu dgu phyag gnyis kyi g.yon thod dbyug phyar ba/ lhor na las khyab 'jug chen po thog ser dang sa g.yo ba'i bdag po/ sku mdog ser nag dbu dgu phyag gnyis kyi g.yon sbrul sum sgril 'debs pa/ byang shar du sha las sgra gcan 'dzin thog ser dang gtib gre'i las mkhan/ sku mdog dkar dmar dbu dgu phyag gnyis kyi g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khram shing 'dzin pa'o// brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal rnam par gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas rnams kyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang bam zhags 'dzin pa/ khros pa'i rna ba krong zhing sna nas gdug pa'i thor rlung 'bud pa/

ral pa'i tshogs gyen du gzengs shing lus mig gis khengs pa ro smad sbrul du 'khyil ba'o// de rnams kyi shar du ma las stag srin zor ba gdong dkar mo stag gi gdong can/ ral pa dmar po la gser gyi zor bas brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi ya bas bskor ba/ g.yas zor bas dgra srog gcod cing g.yon pho lhog sbos nad kyi rkyal pa thogs pa| lhor ra las bam srin dred kyi gdong can ma ser mo/ ral pa nag po lcags kyi khro chu 'dzag pa/ dred lpags kyi ya bas bskor ba/ g.yas zor bas dgra srog gcod cing g.yon ngan skyug glang sna'i nad rkyal thogs pa/ nub tu tsa las kong srin ba glang gdong can ma ser mo/ ral pa dmar po las khrag gi gru char 'bebs pa/ glang lpags kyi ya bas bskor ba/ g.yas zor bas dgra srog gcod cing g.yon ngan skyug khrag gzer gyi nad rkyal thogs pa/ byang du sha las 'brong srin chu srin gyi gdong can ma ljang khu/ ral pa nag po las gnam lcags kyi char 'bebs pa/ chu srin gyi pags pa'i ya bas bskor ba/ g.yas zor bas dgra srog gcod cing g.yon ngan skyug thog gag nad kyi rkyal pa thogs pa/ thams cad kyang snyan nas drag po'i 'brug sgra sgrog cing*/ spyan nas khrag gi mchi ma 'dzag pa/ shangs nas rdzing bud lo nyes gtong ba/ zhal gdangs shing glog ltar 'gyu ba'i ljags las gnam lcags kyi tho lum 'bebs pa/ kha rlangs sprin las gdug pa'i nad yams gtong ba/ thugs las ltas ngan sna tshogs pa'i sprul pa 'gyed pa/ kun kyang srin mo'i cha lugs can srid pa gsum gyi sems can gyi srog la za zhing*| sgrub pa pos drag tu bskul na 'jig rten phung bar byed pa'i mthu rtsal dang ldan pa'o// de rnams kyi phyi rol tu nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa ste nang blon gza' chen po brgyad/ smin drug dang snar ma la sogs pa phyi blon rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams rang rang gi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan sna tshogs pas mdzes pa bstan pa bsrung ba'i las la brtson pa'o// de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du so so'i sa bon las/

shar du lha dkar po zhi ba'i cha lugs can rin po ches brgyan pa pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje smug nag ral pa nyil zhing be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu klu bdud dmar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ljang ser ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar lhor rgyal po dkar ser bam dbyug 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu btsan dmar po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dmu ljang ser nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ byang shar du nag po bdud mdung nag dang ba dan can gsor ba'o// de rnams kyi phyogs bzhir mi nag 'o dod gnam du 'bod pa/ bud med nag mo ral pa nyil nas dul mo gdul ba/ khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar 'phyo zhing dgra la zugs pa/ gzhan yang stag dang*/ spre'u| bya/ gzigs/ byi la/ dom/ dred/ spyang ki/ dur bya la sogs te srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa sprin gyi phung po gtib pa ltar gsal ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing gas mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer dang*/ bdag gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod rgyal dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa spros/ lho nub srin yul laṅka pu ri'i grong khyer nas gza' bdud 'khor bcas kyi snying kha nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings nas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs shing tshil chen dang sha chen gyi dud pa btang*/ rnga dung cha lang gi sgra drag po dang bcas pas dbyangs kyi nga ros 'di skad do// hūm̐ */ ye nas dag pa lhun grub gzhal yas nas// brda dgongs snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma dang*// zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba du ma yis// byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// lha srin stong sde 'khrug pa'i bar snang khams// dgung sngon me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// drang srong chen po gza' bdud rā hu la// sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// srin po yongs kyi gtso mchog ki kaṃ rje// gtum drag 'bar ba gdong dmar dregs pa'i gtso| |yab gcig rak+sha dz+wa la gshegs su gsol// 'dod chags chu ltar 'brub pa'i mching gnam nas// klu dang sa bdag yongs kyi che btsan mo// mdze phol bdag mo sbal mgo khrag mig ma// yum chen rdo rje glog 'gyu gshegs su gsol// nub phyogs khrag mtsho khol ma'i gting mtha' der// rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khyil ba'i khang chen nas// nad bdag ma mo'i tshogs kyi mnga' bdag mo// dpung g.yon ljang sngon chen mo gshegs su gsol// shar lho keng rus thod pa'i ri phug nas// rno ngar go mtshon 'khrigs pa'i nags tshal du// dpal ldan dgra lha yongs kyi rgyal po che// phyag g.yas drang srong dkar ser gnas 'dir byon// mthing ga mun pa gtibs pa'i thum thum nas// rims mtshon du ba phyur ba'i rdzong nang der// bdud dmag dpung chen nyer ba'i kha lo pa// mchu so bdud po rok+ti 'dir 'bod do// mi ro rta ro gdal ba'i thang yangs su// sha khrag rus pa mer ba'i btsan khang nas// khro gtum srin po yongs kyi ded dpon po// mgo bo bi tri pa tra 'dir 'bod do// gtol med sa chen phug yangs gting zab pa// khrag 'bab bam chen gsar rnying gdan gyi steng*// dmu rje ma lus gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i rje// mjug ma ha li ka li da tshur byon// sra brtan brag dmar rtse yi rdzong nang der// ru dar sna tshogs 'phur ba'i nang khrod nas// khu bcas gzer nad bdag po yongs kyi rje// lag g.yon du ba mjug ring 'dur la shog

/sdom sdig sbal pas gang ba'i 'dam rdzab nas// mdze phol shu ba'i kha rlangs 'thibs pa der// klu bdud kun la dbang chen bsgyur ba yi// dpung g.yas khyab 'jug chen po la 'ur shog /khro gtum bu yug 'tshubs pa'i mun phug nas// smyo 'bog brgyal nad mang po lang long der// bgegs dang 'byung po du ma'i pho nya mo// mig snying mche ba sgra gcan 'dzin yang gshegs// dkar ser dmar mthing 'od kyi gur khang nas// gnyan lhog gzer thung phol gyi 'phro 'du can// stag dred ba lang chu srin rngam pa'i gdong*// khyab 'jug srin mo mched bzhi gshegs su gsol// rang yang mkha' la bon du bskor ba yi// rgyu skar gza' dang bzang ngan 'phrod sbyor pa// nyi zla mig dmar lhag phur pa sangs spen// zhi drag gza' chen bdun yang 'phur la shog /brtan nyams g.yo ba'i khyim chen bcu gnyis nas// brtan nyams rgyu skar nyer brgyad gshegs su gsol| |rang rang 'du ba so so'i gnas mchog nas// 'khor gyi lha srin sde brgyad rgyug cing shog /snang zhing srid pa'i yul na gnas pa'i 'khor// bka' gnyan dregs pa thams cad gshegs su gsol// oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// pad nyi ro yi gdan la bzhugs su gsol| |phyi nang gsang rten bla rdo srog 'khor sogs// bris dang bcos pa'i rten dang brtan bzhugs nas// kha dog dri ro ldan pa'i mchod pa la// bskal pa'i bar du dgyes par rol du gsol// hrīḥ shaka ru raka raṃ na ge tsit+ta traṃ ma ma yong za gh+raṃ ha hi ke sha la dzaḥdzaḥ rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ che ba'i che mchog 'jigs byed rā hu la// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// dregs pa pho mo ming sring 'khor bcas la// bstan pa bsrung phyir gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la na mo na maḥ

pra tīts+tsha hoḥ thun mong gi mchod pa ni/ bstan srung drag po 'khor bcas la// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni// dmar chen ar+ghaṃ lbu phreng 'khrigs// mkhris pa'i zhabs bsil mtsho ltar 'khyil// dbang po'i me tog sha chen spos// zhun chen mar me khrag gi dri// tsit+ta'i zhal zas rnga dung dang*// gri rkang 'bod sngags nga ro'i sgra// nam mkha'i khams kun yongs bkang ste// drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ lha chen 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas// khyod kyi dgyes pa'i dam rdzas ni// gza' bdud pha yis gnang ba'i zas| |sha rul khrag rul nya rul dang*// btsos dang rjen sha sna tshogs dang*// ra mchin dmar gyi sha khrag rnams// pha zas yin pas dgyes par rol// gza' bdud ma yis gnang ba'i zas| |dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman dang*// la sman rtsi sman ga pur rnams// ma zas yin pas tshim par rol// stag dom ba lang nya yi snying*// sring mo gdong mo bzhi yi zas// sha sna khrag sna snying sna dang*// klad khrag rkang rus khu bar bcas// 'khor gyi sde brgyad dgyes pa'i rdzas// rang rang dgyes pa'i bza' btung rnams// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la ma hā pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ dam la bzhag pa ni/ lha yi nga rgyal gyis gza' bdud 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor dam tshig gi rdo rje bzhag la/ lce la mna'i btung ba byin pas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran nas sgrub po'i bka' las mi 'da' bar bsam zhing rten gyi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag pañca phul zhing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis// rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir| |dam tshig gnyen po gcig tu bsre// 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// dam las 'das na mgo bo khos/

/'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu// bsrung na dngos grub sna tshogs 'byung*// ma bsrung rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung*// de bas rdo rje'i chu 'thung zhig /bdag kyang dam la mi 'da' na// khyod kyang dam las ma 'da' zhig /gnyis ka dam las mi 'da' 'tshal// gal te dam las 'das pa na// rdo rje'i dmyal bar shi ka re// de bas dam tshig gnyan po srungs// bsgo ba'i stongs grogs gnyen po mdzod// oṃ rā hu la sa ma ya badz+ra pañca a mṛ ta u da ka na rak+kan/ zhes gtor mar bdud rtsi sgron zhing rang gis kyang myong*/ de nas yang bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ mtshan dang ldan pa'i bhan+dha ru// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba// rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos// nyon mongs dug lnga sel ba'i sman// 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba 'di// lha chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dgyes shing tshim par da rol cig /oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes bdud rtsi gtor mar sgron/ rak+ta 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha ru// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i srog rtsa'i khrag /srog chags du ma'i snying khrag dang*// brtan g.yo'i rgyu rkyen rak+ta'i tshogs// myos byed bcud dang sbyar ba yi/ /dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di/ /gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas la 'bul| |rngam zhing dregs pas bzhes su gsol// oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes gtor mar sgron/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gshin rje'i drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgya ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po chen po zhal du hab hub chem chem khrum khrum gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ hrīḥshaka ru raka raṃ na ge tsit+ta traṃ ma ma yong za gh+raṃ ha hi ke sha la dzaḥdzaḥ ma hā ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

ke ta ke ta rā hu la/ yab srin po rak+sha dz+wa la gdong dmar/ yum klu mo rdo rje glog 'gyu sbal mgo khrag mig ma/ sras mchog sprul pa'i gza' bdud chen po rā hu la/ ljang sngon drag po/ drang srong dkar ser/ bdud po rok+ti/ bi tri pa tra/ biṣ+ṇu ra tsa/ du ba mjug ring*/ khyab 'jug chen po sgra gcan 'dzin/ stag srin zor ba gdong*/ bam srin dred mong gdong*/ kong srin ba glang gdong*/ 'brong srin chu srin gdong*/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis sngags 'chang bdag la dgyes pa'i zhal ston cig /sgrub pa'i rtags phyu+ung zhig /phrin las mngon du gyis/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs shig /'khor dang gang zag skyongs shig /dpal dang grags pa sgrubs shig /bdud dang bar chad zlog cig /bgegs dang 'byung po sgrol zhig /mi mthun rkyen ngan zlog cig /zas nor longs spyod spel zhig /srid gsum dbang du bsdus shig /khams gsum zil gyis gnon cig /snyan grags 'brug ltar sgrogs shig /snga dgra dar ba rtsad nas chod cig /phyi dgra sems pa rdul du rlog cig /da dgra bsdo ba phye mar thong zhig /sdang ba'i dgra la chad pa chod cig /srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis chod cig /pho rgyud rus pa rtsad nas chod cig /mo rgyud rak+ta mngal nas skoms shig /dgra sha rlon pa zo shig /dgra khrag dron mo 'thung zhig /dgra snying dmar po phyung zhig /dgra mgo rings par sgril zhig /mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzod cig /chags che ba dang nyam nga ba zlog cig /bsam pa bsgrubs la re ba skongs shig /bkra shis dang phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig /de nas gsang ba gsol gdab ni/ hoḥ sprul pa'i gza' bdud chen po khyod kun bzang he ru ka dang rang bzhin chos nyid kyi ngang du gcig pa/

ngo bo ye shes su mtshungs pa mtshan nyid phrin las thogs med du mnyam pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms pa'i dpa' bo/ snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi yang rje/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi dmag dpon gza' bdud nag po khyod kyis rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor pa bu bzhin du srung ba/ dam can sgrub pa po'i bsam gtan gyi drod nyul ba/ zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag po dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la myur ba/ bstan pa srung ba'i las 'byin pa/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug /sras mchog gza' bdud nag po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rnal 'byor pa bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub bde ba chen po'i zhing khams su bgrod pa'i lam gyi bsu ma dang phrin las mdzod cig /de ltar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam du mi 'jug cing thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyas pa dang*/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du zhing rnam pa kun du phrin las kyi bya ba ji ltar gsol ba thogs med du sgrub pa dang*/ dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bad med du stsol cing ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ mnga' gsol ba ni/ spos dang tshil chen gyi dud pa btang*/ phud dang rak+ta sbreng*/ rol mo sgrog /me tog 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ dam can gza' yi dge bsnyen chen po khyod// sku mdog dud kha 'jigs pa'i mig gis khengs// dbu dgu rngam pa'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgrog /thod sbrul nyi zla'i phreng ba brjid cing rngam// zhal gdang ljags 'dril dug gi mche ba gtsigs// sma ra ag tshom dmar po me ltar 'bar// zhal nas gdug pa'i ngan sngags 'brug ltar sgrog

rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lhar mnga' gsol gyi// dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma ga ṇa'i rdzas// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dkor cha dang*// mthun rdzas spyan gzigs longs spyod dpag yas pa// dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khams bskangs nas// gza' bdud yab yum sras dang bcas la 'bul// gsol lo mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par mdzod// bsnyen no bsten no sgrub bo phrin las mdzod| |bdag 'dod 'bras bu dus 'dir stsal du gsol// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// bstod pa ni/

ltar 'khyug /za byed rngam pa'i sku la bdag bstod do// lha chen khyod kyi sku yi cha rnams las// nyi zla 'bar ba'i ye shes spyan mang po// phyogs bcur glog ltar 'khyug cing me stag 'phro// zur gyis blta dang rnam par bgrad pa yi// re re las kyang gnam lcags thog spros pas// dgra bgegs mgo bo 'gem la bdag bstod do// mche ba gtsigs shing drag po'i zhal rnams las// phaṭa phaṭa k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ nga ro cher sgrog cing*// mthong dug reg pa la sogs dug lnga yi// gdug pa rmongs reng byed la bdag bstod do// stobs ldan khyod kyi 'jigs pa'i sku mchog las// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i nad rims tshogs// /rnam mang du ma'i gzugs kyis bstan pa skyong*// sprul pas gzhan don mdzad la bdag bstod do// khyod kyi yab ni mi bsrun srin po'i rje// khyod kyi yum ni klu rgyal kun gyi gtso// mi bsrun drag po tshar gcod rjes 'dzin pa'i// lha chen sprul pa'i sku la bdag bstod do// thugs kyi sras mchog sprul pa'i gdong mo bzhi// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i phrin las kyis// khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' sgrub po skyong*// dbang chen yum gyur bzhi la bdag bstod do// 'jig rten skyong ba gza' chen brgyad po dang*// bde legs spel mdzad rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad// pho nyar mnga' gsol lha srin sde brgyad dang*// srid gsum 'byung por bcas la bdag bstod do// rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i rjes 'brangs te// gang gis bcol ba'i las kun mdzad pa yi// lha chen dregs pa tshur byon dam rdzas bzhes// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha chen spos dang bdud rtsi rak+ta'i skyems// tsit+ta snying dang dkar gsum klu sman dang*// dam rdzas rgyan gyis spras pa'i gtor ma 'dis// 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa gces par srung ba dang*// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ yang*/ ka dag chos dbyings stong pa'i rang bzhin las// kha dog dmar nag rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus// ga sha sbrul dang rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan// nga rgyal can gyi dgra bo'i gshed ma khyod/ /ca co drag po'i sgra 'byin khyab 'jug che// cha lugs drang srong khros pa'i tshul 'chang ba// ja ril mi mgo'i phreng bas rgyan du byas// nya rgyas zla ba lto ru za ba khyod// ta na sgrol zhing dpa' bo 'jigs pa'i gzugs// tha tshig bsnyel ba med pa'i thugs dam can// da lta bstan srung kun las mthu rtsal che// na ra bstan dgra sgrol ba'i sdig can khyod// pa wa sangs ltar dkar shing mche ba gtsigs// pha rol log 'dren sde dpung zhal du bstabs// ba spu spyan stong me 'od klog 'khyugs pas// ma lus sreg pa'i tsha zer rngam pa khyod// tsa na ka tsam dgra dpung phye mar 'thag

/tsha na gdug pa'i dug dang nad chen 'bebs// dza hri lta log ngan sngags sbyor ba mkhan// wa ler gzigs nas sgrol ba zlog med khyod// zha long lkugs reng smyo 'bog gzir phab nas// za ma dgra bo'i sha khrag la rtag rol// 'a zha'i yul dang skad cig skor nus pa'i// ya spyod can gyi bstan dgra'i rjes gcod khyod// ra sa la sogs gtsug lag sde skyong phyir// la lung med par thog ser drag po 'bebs// sha za khrag 'thung sde brgyad kyis bskor ba'i// sa steng 'gran zla bral ba'i bstan srung khyod// ha sogs yig 'brus byin rlabs gtor ma dang*/ a mṛ ta dang rak+ta 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las kun// da lta nyid du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces dang*/ gzhan yang gzhung las 'byung ba'i bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas bstod/ skabs 'dir man ngag gnad dang ldan pas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥshaka ru raka raṃ na ge tsit+ta traṃ ma ma yong za gh+raṃ ha hi ke sha la dzaḥdzaḥ/ zhes pa ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa 'di la thog mar bsnyen pa'i tshad/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum drug lnga/ dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba gcig /rtags kyi bsnyen pa ni ban de nag po ral pa can dang*/ mon pa dang*/ sngags pa dang*/ btsun pa dang*/ mi nag ral pa can sogs me lce 'bar ba dang*/ sgra dang sa gzhi khyom pa sogs dngos po rnams rmi lam du lan gsum yan chad 'byung zhing kho rang dngos su kha mig khra chem gyis 'byung ba 'di rab bo// grangs su rtags gsum tshang ba gal che la/ 'di ma 'dzom par gong gtad sogs byas na rang phung nges so// 'bod sngags kyang yin pas shin tu gal che bas rtags ma byung bar du bzla'o// rtags ni gzhung du gsal lo// rtsa sngags kyi gsham dzaḥ gcig bzhag pa'i mthar/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha trūṃ che ge mo nṛ dza mā ra ya phaṭa sod sod/ ces pa ni 'bod sngags 'byin 'jug bcug pas bsad sngags kyi sham bu+u btags pa'o/

tshig gnyan po 'di min nam// bram ze'i khye'u khyab 'jug sprin// bstan pa bsrung bar dam 'chos shig /dam nyams sgrol bar dam 'chos shig /de'i tshe tha tshig de min nam// shākya thub pas bka' bsgos pa// ma 'ongs bskal pa'i tha ma la// bla ma la sdang sngags la 'phya// khyad par dben gnas gnyan po 'jig /nyams pa de yi srog rtsa chod// de'i tshe tha tshig de min nam// rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ngo zhes// dam ldan rnal 'byor skyong ngo zhes// dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod do zhes// khyod kyi khas blangs de min nam// gshin rje ya mān+ta ka la// dpal chen mngon rdzogs rgyal po dang*// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal// gsang bdag gtum po'i spyan snga ru// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ngo zhes// rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong ba dang*// bstan pa'i ru tra tshar gcod cing*// bsgo ba'i bka' dang bcol ba'i las// myur du sgrub par ma chad dam// khyad par ya mān+ta ka'i bka'// nga ni dus gsum sngon du byung*// sangs rgyas kun gyi sngon du byung*// nga ni dus gsum phyis kyang 'byung*// nga ni lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe// nga yi bstan pa 'byung bar byed// bstan pa thams cad nub pa'i tshe// las ngan mtshams med byed pa'i tshe// zas ngan lci ba za ba'i tshe// gos ngan dug hrul gyon pa'i tshe| |gnas ngan mkhar spe'u rtsig pa'i tshe// gnyen ngan nye ba 'thab pa'i tshe// dam tshig nyams pa mang ba'i tshe// khyod kyi dam tshig gnyan po de// rnal 'byor gang zhig bslab pa la// de la rtag tu thugs brtse na// dam tshig mang po nyams pa la// nga yis kiṃ kang 'bebs par byed// zhes pa'i dam bzhag 'di yin zhing*// khyod kyi dam bca' gnyan po de// da lta rnal 'byor bdag bskul lo// khas blangs bzhin du phrin las mdzod// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// kyai/

gza' bdud 'khor bcas tshur gson dang*// rgyal ba'i bka' la mi brten med// zab mo'i chos la mi sems med/ /mna' dang khrims la mi gnas med/ /zas dang skom la mi chags med// do nub khyod kyi thugs dam skong*// nyams chag gso zhing zhig ral gso| |lha la bshags bgyid sems 'khon sbyangs// phud 'dren 'dza' ba'i gzhung zhig byed// do nub byams pa'i lan zhig glon// do nub snga ma'i btang rag gtong*// do nub phyi ma'i zhu skyems 'bul// do nub las kyi gnyer zhig bsgo// kyai/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu// gza' bdud 'khor bcas phud la dgyes// bar du tshogs kyis mi mchod rgyu// 'jigs byed chen po tshogs la dgyes// tha mar lhag mas mi mchod rgyu// sring bzhi sde brgyad lhag la dgyes// lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu// 'khu ldog dam las 'das kyi dogs// rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyu// sku gsung thugs la 'du 'bral med// phud la dgyes pa phud la rol// lhag la dgyes pa lhag la rol// ba ling gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod// bsam pa sgrub la re ba skongs// hrīḥ khyab 'jug chen po tshur gson dang*// grogs la gzhung med mi srid kyi// byams la drin med mi srid kyi// mdza' la gdong med mi srid kyi// chos skyong mthu med mi srid kyi// chad tho mi sgrub mi srid kyi// tshogs dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod// zas kyi ngo zhig cis kyang gyis// chad pa'i gzhung zhig bdag kyang srong*// bdag gi tshig 'di khyod kyis nyon// sgrub pa'i gzhung 'di nga yis srong*// bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mdzod| |gnyis ka las kyi gzhung bsrang 'tshal// smos so chad do thugs dam can// do nub chad dang tho la byon// do nub mna' dang tho la byon// do nub mna' dang khrims la byon// grogs por bgyis so gzhung ma ngan// mdza' bor bgyis so khrel ma shor// mna' tho bgyis so mna' ma za// rje bor byas so dbang ma che// bran ltar bskul lo rgyu ma ngan// dam tshig gnyan po mi sems med// dang po'i chad don 'di min nam// gza' bdud dug gi spu gri dang*// rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis// dam tshig 'da' bar ma chad dam// dam can ma g.yel phrin las mdzod// bcol ba'i las 'di ma byas na// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' yang bslus// sngags 'chang rnal 'byor yid kyang 'chad// dang po chad pa'i mna' zos na| |dam tshig nyams pa'i chad pa 'ong*/

/bka' yi dmod pas sdig par mchi'o// de bas dam las ma 'da' bar// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// phur kha zlog pa'i dus la bab| |zor kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// byad kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// mi kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// dal kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// nad kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// rims kha zlog pa'i dus la bab/ /yams kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// gdon kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// khram kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// sho kha zlog pa'i dus la bab// lo skag zlog pa'i dus la bab| |zla skag zlog pa'i dus la bab// zhag skag zlog pa'i dus la bab// ltas ngan zlog pa'i dus la bab// mtshan ngan zlog pa'i dus la bab// gtad mnan zlog pa'i dus la bab| |zlog cig bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod// gsol lo mchod do srung ma'i tshogs// sod cig thul zhig dgra dang bgegs// gtad do gnyer ro thugs dam skong*// khyod dang sngags 'chang bdag cag gnyis// bskal pa zhig kyang mi 'bral lo// bos so khyab 'jug snyan ma sra// g.yab bo gza' bdud spyan ma brtul// bsten no drang srong rgyang ma ring*// sgrub bo gter bdag gong ma g.yel// bskul lo lha chen phrag ma dog /rbad do 'jigs byed mthu ma chung*// thugs dam g.yel bar ma mdzad cig /thugs dang blo kha ci nyer mdzod// brtse gdung byams sems ci cher mdzod// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ji lta bar// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod// 'khor srung rkyen zlog bar chad sol// le lo snyoms las ma mdzad cig /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig /rdzun dang g.yo rgyu ma mdzad cig /rnal 'byor bdag gi re ba skongs// tshe sring dpal bskyed 'byor pa spel// snyan pa sgrub la grags pa sgrogs// 'jig rten gsum po dbang du sdus// dge ba zhi ba'i las sgrub dang*// rgyas dang dbang gis thams cad gnon// mngon spyod drag pos dgra 'dul te// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// legs pa thams cad sgrub pa dang*// nyes pa thams cad 'gog pa dang*// bsam pa thams cad sgrub pa dang*/

re ba thams cad skong ba dang*// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mdzod// ces dang*// gzhan yang dgos pa dang bstun nas don gang yin gyi phrin las bcol zhing las kyi gnyer gtad drag po bya'o// bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs ma yin pa'i mchod 'bul gsol kha dus gtor sogs kyi skabs dmigs bya med cing drag las mi byed na/ tshogs byas pa'i tshogs lhag gi rjes gtor bsngos kyi mjug tu bstod pa gang rung dang bcas pas gtor mar dpal 'bar btsugs nas sgrub khang steng gi lho nub mtshams su 'bul// yang drag las dang bsnyen sgrub min par tshogs mchod mi byed na skabs 'dir gtor 'bul rjes chog rnams bya/ gzhan bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gdong gtad mnan sreg 'phang gsum sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gang byed kyang tshogs mchod byed na tshogs lhag gi mjug tu bya zhing*/ tshogs mchod mi byed na skabs 'dir bya dgos so// da ni tshogs kyi mchod pa bya bar 'dod na/ tshogs rdzas ma tshang ba med pa dang*/ ma da na sogs legs par bshams la bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las tshogs kyi snod bhan+dha'i gzhong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng gi dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs bzhir bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ/ slar yang dbus su mū las dri chu/ shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta/ nub byang du shū las byang sems/ byang shar du ma las go ro tsa na/ de rnams kyi steng du māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐ gi sna rlung gis rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ ma dag ba'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ dag pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

zhes tshogs mchod byin gyis brlabs nas/ dang po spros la mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// dbang bskur byin rlobs smin grol stsol// 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas// chos skyong gza' bdud yab yum la/ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// nam mkha' yangs pa'i gzhal yas nas// bka' gnyan dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs la// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /ces gtor ma bran// sman raka sgron/ tshogs bar pa spros la bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bla ma yi dam dpal mgon srung mar bcas// rnal 'byor bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// bdag cag ma rig nyon yid rnam g.yeng gis// sku yi phyag rgya ma gsal sngags ma dag /ting 'dzin mchog g.yel phyi nang gsang rten dben// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag kun// lha chen drag po 'khor dang bcas la bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*// sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes tshogs dang sman rak+ta gtor mar sgron/ yi ge brgya pas bshags so// tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/ zan ling khrag chen gyis sbags pa la dmigs bya yod na de'i ming rus snying khar bcug dri ma byugs gzir dug gdab/ dmigs bya med na zan ling khrag byugs pa sha dum ong skyu chang bu gtor chung dang bcas pa thod phor ram lcags snod du bzhag par sman rak+ta bran/ dgug gzhug drag po gsum byas la dpang gzu ni/ kwai/ ye shes lha yis nam mkha' gang*// sprul pa'i lha tshogs bar snang gang*// 'jig rten lha tshogs sa gzhi gang*// ye shes spyan dang rdzu 'phrul zhabs// thugs rje'i stobs ldan khyod rnams kyis// sdang byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba yi// gzu dang dpang por bzhugs nas kyang*// legs nyes bden rdzun stangs phye zhig

/ces dang*/ khro gtum dang bcas pas bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bskal pa'i me dpung klong dkyil nas// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// gza' bdud chen po rā hu la// klu srin tshogs pa'i mthu nus can// sku stod mi la sku smad sbrul// dbu dgu ral pa gyen la 'khyil// mthing mdog mgo lus mig gis gang*// spyan dmar khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// gza' bdud chen po khyod bskul lo// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di// chu srin zhags pas lus ngag chings// rwa yi dug mda' snying la rgyob// nyi zla'i rjes gcod shar nub rgyug /dgra bo gu gu thul du sod// dgra bo thams cad gyur mid thong*// nyin dang mtshan du bla tshe phrogs// rā hu la yi dus la bab// khyod kyi mthu rtsal sprul pa las// shar du biṣ+ṇu ra tsa ste// shar gyi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// shar lho rā hu la yin te// shar lho mtshams kyi dgra rnams sgrol// lho nas khyab 'jug chen po ste// lho yi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// lho nub bi tri pa tra ste// lho nub mtshams kyi dgra rnams sgrol// nub tu ljang sngon drag po ste// nub kyi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// nub byang du ba mjug ring ste// nub byang phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// byang du bdud po rok+ti ste// byang gi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// byang shar bi nā ya ka ste// byang shar mtshams kyi dgra rnams sgrol// shar nas stag srin zor ba gdong*// shar gyi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// lho nas bam srid dred mo gdong*// lho yi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// nub nas kong srin ba lang gdong*// nub kyi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// byang gi 'brong srin chu srin gdong*// byang gi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di// da lta myur du khug la shog

/mi nor zas gsum phung du chug /nad yams 'khrug pa gri ru sod// bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog /ces bskul zhing rbad do// rgyas pa drag tu bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ nub nas shar du bskyod tsa na// ljang sngon drang srong khros pa'i sku// du kha me yi 'od zer 'phro// mgo dgu kha gdang mche ba gtsigs// mgo lus med par mig gis gang*// sna 'bud lha srin ral pa gsig /g.yas pas chu srin zhags pa thogs// g.yon pas lcags sgrog dmar po 'dzin// srid pa ma mo'i 'khor gyis bskor// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di// thog ser gri thab nad kyis sod// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// ma rak+mo baṃ hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ shar lho nub byang bskyod tsa na// drang srong dkar ser khros pa'i sku// mtshon cha me yi 'od zer 'phro// mgo dgu kha gdang mche ba gtsigs// mgo lus med par mig gis gang*// mig mang nang nas tsha tsha 'khrugs// sna 'bud snang srid ral pa gsig /g.yas pas chu srin zhags pa thogs// g.yon pas tri shūl g.yab nag thogs// dgra lha'i rgyal po'i dus la bab// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di// thog yams nad kyis sod la shog /rā hu la yi dus la bab// tsa ba se yi hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ byang nas lho ru bskyod tsa na// bdud po rok+ti mthing nag sku// 'od zer sprul pa'i dug mda' 'gyed// mgo dgu kha gdang mche ba gtsigs// mgo lus med par mig gis gang*// sna 'bud lha srin dug gi gding*// g.yas pas chu srin zhags pa thogs// g.yon pas bdud zhags nag po thogs// bdud kyi dmag dpung dus la bab// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di// thog ser bdud nad drag pos sod| |bdud pho rok+ti'i dus la bab// du ru ki hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ lho nas byang du bskyod tsa na// bi tri pa tra khros pa'i sku// 'jigs byed dmar nag me 'od 'gyed// mgo dgu kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs// mgo lus med par mig gis gang*// sna 'bud lha srin mthor rlung 'bud// g.yas pas chu srin zhags pa thogs// g.yon pas urmo'i gri chen 'debs// gdug pa srin po'i dus la bab/

/bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /nad thog 'khrug pa drag pos sod/ /bi tri pa tra rak+sha tri ya hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ shar nas nub tu bskyod tsa na// biṣ+ṇu ra tsa khros pa'i sku| |dmu bdud kha la drag rtsal can// mgo dgu kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs// mgo lus med par mig gis gang*// sna nas dug gi rlangs pa 'thor// g.yas pas chu srin zhags pa thogs| |g.yon pas stag chen mgo bo phyar// btsan rgod rnams kyi dus la bab// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di// btsan gzer nad kyis sod la shog /ha li ka li'i dus la bab| |a tri raṃ traṃ hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ nub byang shar lhor bskyod tsa na// gsod byed mjug ring khros pa'i sku// sngo nag ral pa mtshon char 'khyil// mgo dgu kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs// mgo lus med par mig gis gang*// sna 'bud gnam lcags bu yug 'tshub// g.yas pas chu srin zhags pa thogs// g.yon pas thod dbyug 'phyar zhing rdeg /gsod byed gshin rje'i dus la bab// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di// tshe srog dus mtha' stung la shog /du ba mjug ring dus la bab// sa ma san yaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ */ lho nas byang du bskyod tsa na// lha chen khyab 'jug brjid pa'i sku/ /drang srong ser nag khros pa'i zhal/ /mgo dgu kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /mgo lus med par mig gis gang*// sna 'bud thog dang ser ba 'bebs// g.yas pas chu srin zhags pa thogs// g.yon pas sbrul zhags dgra bo 'ching*// klu bdud yongs kyi dus la bab// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di| |thog ser mi nad sbos grir sod// khyab 'jug chen po'i dus la bab// nā ga shrī hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ */ byang shar lho nub bskyod tsa na// bi nā ya ka brjid pa'i sku// mi bsrun sgra gcan drag rtsal can// mgo dgu kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs// mgo lus med par mig gis gang*// sna 'bud nad ngan bu yug 'tshub// g.yas pas chu srin zhags pa thogs// g.yon pas khram shing rdo rje can// dregs pa sde brgyad dus la bab// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di// thog ser 'thib gris sod la shog

/bi nā ya ka'i dus la bab// sha sin tri hūm̐/ zhes bskul/ slar yang 'di skad du/ hūm̐ */ nga ni thod phreng khros pa'i sku// nga ni dregs byed kun gyi rje// nga ni khro bo drag po'i sku// dam nyams sgrol ging chen po ste// khro bo'i pho nya dpag med 'gyed// sdang byed gdug pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zung*/ /zhags pa can gyis yan lag chings// lcags sgrogs can gyis dbang po sdoms// dril bu can gyis rdul du rlogs| |lus srog dbugs dang bral bar gyis// brgyal zhing reng dang brlag tu chug /mtshon sna lnga yi 'phro 'du yis// dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par bya// hūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi snying rtsa yaṃ yaṃ// srog rtsa la rbad rbad// snying tsit+ta srog gtubs gtubs// zhes phur bu lag tu thogs nas/ rang gi lag pa'i steng du phyag na rdo rje gtum po/ lag mthil g.yas su gshin rje/ g.yon pa'i mthil du ro langs dang e ka dzā ti/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong la rak+sha dz+wa la/ mthe bong g.yon na rdo rje klog 'gyu+u/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo la bi tri pa tra/ gung mo la rā hu la/ srin lag la sgra gcan 'dzin/ mthe'u chung la du ba mjug ring*/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mo la khyab 'jug /gung mo la biṣ+ṇu ra tsa/ srin lag la ra tsa ka/ mthe'u chung la ljang sngon drag po/ g.yas pa'i 'og tu stag srin dang bam srin/ g.yon pa'i 'og tu kong srin dang 'brong srin/ de'i 'og mthar gza' skar sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpon gyis bskor ba/ phur bu bsgril zhing btab pas lha rnams kyis dgra bo'i tshe srog hab hab gsol nas rnam shes phyag rdor gyi thugs kar yer gyis spros par gyur par bsam zhing*/ gri lcags kyi phur bu thal mo'i bar du sgril zhing bskul tshig ltar gnas so sor sgril zhing 'di skad do// hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i sku// sku stod rngam brjid khros pa la// phyag gnyis rdo rje phur bu bsnams// sku smad zur gsum kī la ya// srog gshed khros pa'i dbal dang ldan// lte ba'i dkyil du kī lā ya// badz+ra kī li ki la ya ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza be tī lī e ka dzā ti hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭaḥ

kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod/ hūm̐ */ khrag mtsho rol ba'i khri steng na// srin po rak+sha khros pa la// sngo nag dbu gsum brjid pa la// g.yas g.yon dbyug to khrag mtsho bsnams// sku smad zur gsum kī la ya// srog rtsa gcod pa'i dus la bab// snying gi dkyil du kī la ya// badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod/ hūm̐ */ zla gam rak+ta'i dkyil 'khor nas// rdo rje glog 'gyu khros pa la// dmar nag dbu gsum rab tu rngam// g.yas gzhon sbrul zhags khrag mtsho bsnams// sku smad zur gsum kī la ya| |mgo lus phral ba'i dus la bab/ /dkar nag mtshams su kī la ya// badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod/ hūm̐ */ nub kyi phyogs nas skur bzhengs pa| |sku mdog ljang nag lus dpung che// dbu dgu phyag gnyis spyan stong bgrad// g.yas g.yon zhags pa lcags sgrog 'dzin// sku smad zur gsum kī la ya// dpung pa g.yon par kī la ya// oṃ traka rak+sha snying kha raka traka ma ma hril ye shig rbad hril shar bh+yo badz+ra kī la ki la ya ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza be tī lī e ka dzā ti hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭaḥ kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod/ hūm̐ */ shar lho mtshams nas skur bzhengs pa// drang srong dkar ser dbu dpung che// dbu dgu phyag gnyis spyan stong bgrad// g.yas g.yon sbrul zhags tri shū la| |sku smad zur gsum kī la ya// lag pa g.yas la kī la ya// oṃ traka rak+sha a se me ru ru ma ma ru lu ru lu hur thums ma ma traka rak+sha hri shar sraṃ nṛ mā ra ya bh+yo badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod/ hūm̐ */ byang gi phyogs nas skur bzhengs pa// bdud po rok+ti dbu dpung che// sku mdog mthing nag dbu dgu gsum// g.yas g.yon sbrul bdud zhags pa bsnams// sku smad zur gsum kī la ya// gsang ba'i dkyil du kī la ya// oṃ pa sha mi ki yaka phor pha du ka mā ra ya hu la hur thums shar dril rbad ya ru ru phra phra thums thums badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod/
